title: crataegus oxyacantha f. laciniata
intro: Crataegus oxyacantha f. laciniata, commonly known as Cut-leaf Hawthorn, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. Cut-leaf Hawthorn is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing blood pressure and cholesterol levels, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to inhibit the uptake of calcium into cardiac cells, thereby exerting a cardioprotective effect. The bioactive constituents of Cut-leaf Hawthorn include flavonoids, such as vitexin and quercetin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
